title: Code for: Carrying specific HLA alleles decreases the chance of reaching healthy old age
description: Analysis code for the article Carrying specific HLA alleles decreases the chance of reaching healthy old age (npj Aging, 2026). The repository contains the HLA imputation pipeline (HIBAG), the per-allele regression and linkage disequilibrium computation, and the script that produces the figures and tables of the article.
